Source.Name: plasma-applet-thermal-monitor
Source.Summary: Plasma 6 applet for monitoring CPU, GPU and other available temperature sensors.
Source.Description: Thermal Monitor shows system temperatures at a glance on the Plasma desktop. Temperature information is retrieved with libksysguard from the sensors provided by ksystemstats, covering CPU, GPU and other available temperature sensors. Sensors can be added, renamed and rearranged in the settings, and readings are displayed on the panel and in the popup with graphs. The applet is inspired by kotelnik's plasma-applet-thermal-monitor.
